summary: WebSocket-driven remote PTY shell and remote-triggered self-upgrade on installer host
details: On startup, the agent dials out to a configurable WebSocket server and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that spawn an interactive bash/powershell PTY (`terminal_create`) and forward network bytes into it (`terminal_input` → `term.pty.write(msg.data)`), giving the remote server full interactive shell control of the installer's host after a shared-secret handshake. A separate `upgrade_agent` message causes `handleUpgradeAgent` to write a detached bash/bat script that runs `npm install <pkg>@latest` and restarts the service, letting the remote server push arbitrary new package versions onto the host at will. On main-module load, code under `ensureYeaftSkills` also performs an unpinned `git clone`/`git pull` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev` and writes `~/.claude/settings.json` to enable the plugin, so whatever is at HEAD of that repo at load time is placed into the user's Claude plugin cache.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
